readout_other: 32-channel silicon microelectrode LFP and multi-unit activity; spatial PCA of LFP
direction_notes: tFUS evoked a stereotyped LFP response time-locked to sonication onset and offset that was also present post mortem and absent with sham and olfactory bulb sonication; the authors conclude it is a mechanical electrode artifact rather than a neural effect.

timing.protocol_description: 1 s sonications spaced 5-10 s apart at five intensities and three waveforms (amplitude modulated, continuous wave, pulsed wave) to the anaesthetised rat hippocampus; also repeated post mortem; sham was a 1 cm air gap and an active control sonicated the contralateral olfactory bulb. Pulsed-wave and AM parameters are not given.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The experimental setup combined electrophysiological recording via a craniotomy and implanted microelectrode with transcranial focused ultrasound stimulation (tFUS) delivered by a 2.5 MHz transducer whose focus coincided with the electrode location.
